proposal.title: No Black-Box Grants: Ratify the Rules Before SPP Is Absorbed

decisions.summary: Eight positive MVF ballots; reasoning described the Grants Charter and commit–reveal evaluator manifest as novel and non-duplicative.
Eighteen positive credit assignments; broad but non-dominant support.
Three positive curves; evaluator reasoning explicitly noted diminishing marginal value after approximately $124 prior funding.
Seven evaluators assigned merit level 6; notes again highlighted SPP conditionality and commit–reveal AI screening.
Forty ballots included the proposal. Prior funding of $195 was repeatedly cited as the reason remaining marginal value was low but positive.

caveats: No separate eligibility attestation was exposed in the inspected lookup/indexed records; slate/allocation presence is the confirmed evidence used here.
S-process ballot records exposed a single MVF payload rather than separate initial and final curves.
No additional in-window August 5 decision was found in the inspected records; August 7 decisions were outside the requested window.
